run_extract_web_documents: run the CLI script to extract web documents from an HTML dataset using CommonCrawlWebDocumentExtractor
run_html_to_web_documents: run the html_to_web_documents method to convert raw HTML into structured web documents
run_download_images: run the download_images method to fetch all images from extracted web documents using multithreading
run_create_dataset_images: run the create_dataset_images method to build a dataset from downloaded images
run_save_split_sharded_dataset: run the save_split_sharded_dataset method to save the final dataset in sharded format
